detail: Public Announcement-Open Offer -  Corporate Professionals Capital Private Limited has Submitted to the Exchange a copy of offer opening public announcement and corrigendum to the detailed public statement under Regulation 18(7) of SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011 (SEBI (SAST) Regulations, 2011) for the attention of the shareholders of the Shankara Building Products Limited (Target Company).
